Kasturba Hospital, Mumbai | After detailed deliberation the committee opined that the study should be a controlled study comparing with the standard of care/supportive therapy as available. Drug :Mesenchymal cells derived from bone marrow | M/s Health Care Global HCG Cancer Center, Bangalore | In the light of COVID 19 situation an urgent meeting for fast track approval was organised through webX portal. The firm presented their proposal for permission to conduct clinical trial with the product. The committee members has requested the firm to submit/clarify the following : 1.Detailed CMC data including characterization etc., of the product manufactured. 2.Inclusion of pulmonologist in the investigators, 3.Inclusion criteria should be properly defined with reference to category / severity of patients, involved in study. 4.The outcome parameters to be evaluated, the decision on concomitant treatments and patient monitoring should be clearly defined in the protocol. 5.Justification for the proposed single arm study rather than two arm study with control arm of Standard of care needs to be provided to consider the matter further.

12-35/17-DC, Bronchipret | M/s GS Pharmabutor | In light of the earlier recommendation of the SEC held on 03.09.2020, the firm presented the revised clinical trial protocol before the committee. After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended that the clinical trial protocol should be revised as under 1) The study should include the duration of treatment as 14 days. 2) “Patient who needs antibiotics” mentioned in the exclusions criteria should be deleted. 3) The proportion of patients who requires antibiotics should be a secondary endpoint. 4) PK analysis in respect of a constituent should be the part of the clinical trial. 5) The sample size should be based on statistical justification Accordingly, the firm should submit the revised protocol for review by the committee As per the requirement Phytopharmaceuticals drug should be purified fraction of plant having minimum four qualitatively and quantitatively assessed ingredients. Therefore, the applicant should submit the detailed characterisation of the product in respect of the ingredients along with chromatograph etc. considering that it contains the extract of two herbs. The ingredients should be part of composition of the drug product.

12-25/16-DC Gadoteridol solution for injection 0.5 M | M/s. Imaging product (India) Pvt. Ltd | The firm presented their proposal along with the clinical data and the justification for Phase III clinical trial waiver. The committee noted that the product is already approved in 23 countries including USA, EU etc. The committee also noted that this product is a macrocyclic Gadolinium agent which is more stable and has a lower propensity to release gadolinium than linear agents. Also, there are only two approved macrocyclic products available in the country. It is also noted that with the linear agents under review for safety issues (deposition of Gadolinium in brain) and there will be need for more macrocyclic agents. After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended for grant of permission to import and market of the product subject to the condition that the firm should conduct a Phase IV clinical trial in at least 100 patients within 12 months after approval of the product. Accordingly, the firm should submit the Phase IV clinical trial protocol before launching the product for review by the committee.

12-07/2014-DC Gadoxetate disodium 0.25 mmol/ml Solution for Injection | M/s. Bayer Pharmaceuticals | The firm presented the justification for the waiver of Phase III Clinical Trial as:- 1. Unmet need and 2. Diagnostic benefits of the product are independent to any differences in ethnic factors. After detailed deliberation, the committee was of the opinion that there is no safety data available in Indian population. The studies quoted/ mentioned by the firm did not evaluate the variation in ethnicity as an objective. In addition, the metabolizing capacity of the liver in Indian population may vary, which can affect the safety.
